dialogue.en: Is there any overtime available this week? I could use the extra hours.
dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.zh: 这周有加班吗？我想多干点。

dialogue.en: Actually yes, we're short-staffed on Saturday.
dialogue.speaker: Supervisor

dialogue.en: I can do Saturday. Is overtime paid at time and a half?
dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.zh: 周六我可以。加班费是 1.5 倍吗？

dialogue.en: Yes, anything over 40 hours is time and a half.
dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.zh: 对，超过 40 小时的部分都是 1.5 倍。
